pr_title: UX: show complete URL path if website domain is same as instance domain

validations.droid_claim:
[P1] `include_website_name` won't be invoked (missing `?` suffix)

ActiveModel::Serializers only recognizes conditional include hooks named `include_<attr>?`. As written, `include_website_name` will never run, so `website_name` may be serialized unconditionally (and will also call `website_name` even when `website` is blank). Rename to `include_website_name?` (and keep the `website.present?` guard).
validations.impact: website_name is always serialized even when website is blank, bypassing the intended conditional include guard. This causes unnecessary computation and potentially empty/nil website_name values in the API response.
validations.reasoning: Every other conditional include method in user_serializer.rb uses the `?` suffix (e.g., include_email?, include_card_image_badge_id?, include_card_image_badge?, include_stats?, include_suspend_reason?, etc.). The method at line 153 is `include_website_name` without `?`, so ActiveModel::Serializers will not recognize it as a conditional include hook. The `website_name` attribute (declared at line 43) will always be serialized, and the `website.present?` guard at line 154 will never be checked by the framework.
validations.code_evidence:
Line 153: `def include_website_name` (missing `?`)
All other include methods have `?`: line 117 `def include_email?`, line 161 `def include_card_image_badge_id?`, line 169 `def include_card_image_badge?`, line 201 `def include_stats?`, etc.
